snippet.title: Exark | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Exark is a run-based engine builder where you command a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, hire crew with unique skills, and exploit powerful synergies to survive your voyage to the rim of the world.


Exark releases on the following platforms:
- Steam  on Q2 2026 - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3435610

Popular descriptions: Roguelite, Auto Battler, City Builder, PvE, Roguelike

Exark is a single player game.

Exark has a demo available so you can try it before you buy it.

Developed by Robot Cat Limited and published by Goblinz Publishing.


Check more upcoming trailers from https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXPLuh7Rmt-uU_6hHJXZUq6Z539FOpMrx
